The Company continues to expect full year 2026 total revenue in the range of $360 million to $366 million, representing growth of approximately 9% to 11% year-over-year, compared to total revenue of $329.5 million in 2025.
The Company now expects full year 2026 Adjusted EBITDA in the range of $50 million to $52 million, compared to Adjusted EBITDA of $44.8 million in 2025.
The Company’s prior 2026 Adjusted EBITDA guidance expectation was $49 million to $51 million.
